_: Commanding the King's hosts (realm/scripts/host_command.gd; Warcraft III's fixed command card and ground ring, Total War's banner that glows when selected and its route on the campaign map). on: the switch (or --hosts=on / --hosts=off). pick_px: how near the pointer must be to a host's standard, in screen pixels, to select it. ring: the ground ring under a selected host (radius in world units, plus so much per company, up to max; colour). glow: the light on a selected host's banner. route: the dotted line to where a host is ordered (dot size and spacing in world units; colour, and alpha for a host not selected). town_reach: an order given this near a town's centre, in world units (a tile is 4), goes to the town rather than to the ground. orders: the command card, left to right, each with its icon (realm/assets/icons) and words on hover; its hotkey is the Input Map action host_<order> (keys.gd, changeable in Settings).

orders.tip: March: then click where on the map, or a town (right-click also marches)
Garrison: then click a town of yours or of a house sworn to you
Return: march home to the King's seat
Split: half its companies stand apart as a host of their own
